description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Palladium Myr.
Ertha Jo's second ability triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Palladium Myr.
Repeat.
